name: dnstwist
title: dnstwist
description: dnstwist — typo-squat / lookalike-domain detection for brand-protection workflows. Generates permutations of DNSTWIST_DOMAIN (homoglyphs, bitsquatting, character omission/insertion, transposition, etc.) and resolves them. DNSTWIST_REGISTERED_ONLY=true (default) returns only resolving permutations; DNSTWIST_MX_CHECK=true tests whether each lookalike accepts mail (strong phishing signal — those land as 'high' severity in Faraday).
